[b]March 16, 2025  Port Thriump, Etherniasti[/b]

Standing before a gathered crowd in Victory Square, Minister of Public Transport, Lorian Valstir, adjusted his collar and ran his tongue absentmindedly over the edge of his well-groomed moustache. It was a habit that had become something of a signaturewhether in deep thought or public speeches, his moustache always seemed to require an occasional taste.

"People of Etherniasti, today marks the beginning of a bold new step in our commitment to a cleaner, more sustainable nation," he declared, pausing for a moment to flick his tongue against the neatly waxed curl of his moustache before continuing.

"Effective immediately, every Sunday, the streets of Port Thriump will be car-free. This initiative is not only about reducing emissions but about reclaiming our city for the people. Families will be able to walk freely, children can play safely, and businesses will thrive in a cleaner, healthier environment."

Government Investment in Public Transport

To ensure smooth implementation, the government has pledged significant investments in public transport, including:

Increased bus and tram frequency, with priority given to high-demand areas.

Reduced Sunday fares, making public transport the most affordable option.

Expansion of cycling infrastructure, including new lanes and bike rental stations.

The introduction of electric buses, aligning with Etherniastis commitment to green energy.

Valstir licked his moustache againa nervous but oddly deliberate motionbefore continuing, Port Thriump will lead the way, but this is just the beginning. If this policy is successful, we will explore expanding Car-Free Sundays to other cities, making Etherniasti a true leader in environmental responsibility.

Public Reactions & Adjustments

The announcement sparked a mix of excitement and concern. Environmentalists hailed it as a historic step, while some businesses expressed worries over logistics. To address this, the government is working on alternative delivery schedules and offering support to businesses adapting to the change.

A New Vision for the City

As the speech concluded, the first Car-Free Sunday was already in effect. People strolled through Port Thriumps now-quiet streets, children cycled freely, and street musicians played without the usual hum of engines in the background.

Lorian Valstir stepped away from the podium, his moustache slightly damp from all the licking, yet his expression one of quiet satisfaction. As Etherniasti took its first major step towards a greener, cleaner future, he whispered to himself, A fine policy and a fine moustache.

[b]16th March 2025 - The Great Parliamentary Assembly[/b]
The various ministers of Hydronia were gathered once again in the huge, echoing chamber of the great parliamentary assembly. Minister of Defence Tosun Nedjet got up from his seat and cleared his throat. Hello my fellow ministers, thank you for attending todays session. I have a new proposal to make. he said. Discussion began across the chamber. SILENCE! Cried the president. The ministers obeyed. Carry on mr Nedjet.
Thank you mr president. As I was saying, I have brought forward a new proposal. I would like to propose an order to allow an amount of limited intervention in the Sal-Baliz controlled territories of the western shamatine deserts. As you will all be aware of, we have an ongoing operation inside their territory, but it is purely intelligence based. I believe that the time for military action has come. Yesterday the first two THEP satellites were launched into orbit and they have revealed some disturbing scenes. Towns and villages lie in smouldering ruins across the continent, thousands dead. We cant allow this to continue! I believe that a campaign of targeted bombings on Sal-Baliz military compounds is necessary to destroy this malevolent group once and for all! In addition to this, ground forces should also be deployed if the Sal-Baliz attempts to expand their territory, which would put our ally, the ULR at risk. Thank you,. The minister returned to his seat as applause and anger erupted from his colleagues.
Let the debate begin, said the president.
Are you crazy! This is only going to worsen the situation in the deserts! The environment is already of port condition thanks to the Sal-Balizs disregard for the planet. If we begin bombing campaigns, the central shamat region will be completely obliterated! Shouted the minister of environmental affairs.
Of course the environment is going to be damaged, but its not like we are going to bomb everything! Only military targets will be affected and they are located in sparsely populated areas anyway! Not to mention the fact that if we do nothing, the people will die from the brutality of the Sal-Baliz regime. Replied Nedjet.
I agree with mr Nedjet, we cant leave these people to die. We must send aid to them immediately, and if that means we have to intervene militarily then so be it. Said the minister of Foreign affairs.

The debate went on for hours until an agreement could finally be reached. After three rounds of voting and slowly adjusting the terms of the ideas, order #765 was put to vote in the house of governors, where it won the vote by a small margin. This order gave the military permission to begin operation Blazing fury. This operation would involve bombings of large Sal-Baliz military targets and ground troops are to be put on standby for any possible threat to the ULRs shamatine territory by Sal-Baliz. The navy will also be put on standby for any potential threat to the ULR mainland or any THEP members.

The president was sat in his office, contemplating the decision of his parliament and how he would later address the nation to inform them of the military operation. He called on his minister of foreign affairs, Halis Erdemir.
You called for me sir? He said as he walked into the presidential office. Yes mr Erdemir, I did. Could you please inform our allies of the decision.
Yes sir. Later that day a message would be sent to all THEP nations and the ULR to inform them of operation Blazing Fury.
